parent.title: [{{date}}] Daily content pipeline
description: ## Daily Content Pipeline — {{date}}
Coordinate today's content production. You are the orchestrator — unblock downstream tasks as each step completes.
## Your responsibilities
1. When SEO Expert finishes briefs: review them, then unblock the Copywriter task (set it to `todo`)
2. When Copywriter finishes articles + PRs: unblock the Frontend Designer task (set it to `todo`)
3. When Designer finishes images: unblock the Legal Expert task (set it to `todo`)
4. When Legal approves: your merge task gets unblocked — do final review and merge
Subtasks track the individual steps.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO brief: 3 article topic recommendations
description: ## Daily Content Pipeline — {{date}}
Research and provide keyword-backed briefs for 3 blog article topics.
For each topic:
- **Target keyword** and search volume/difficulty estimate
- **Headline suggestion** — SEO-optimized and compelling
- **Content angle** — practical value for non-technical professionals
- **Recommended structure** — headings, word count, internal links
## Output
Post 3 briefs as a comment on this task.
## When done
1. Set this task to `done`
2. @mention **@Content Manager** in a comment so they can review the briefs and unblock the Copywriter
## Deadline
Complete by 11:00 CET so the Content Manager can review before handing off to the Copywriter.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Write articles and open PRs
description: ## Daily Content Pipeline — {{date}}
Write full articles based on article briefs from the Content Manager.
For each article:
1. Follow the **Git Publishing Procedure** in CLAUDE.md
2. Create branch `content/{{date}}_<slug>`
3. Write the article in `src/content/blog/<slug>.md`

4. Include an `imageHint` field in frontmatter — a short description (10-20 words) of what the hero image should depict, specific to the article content (e.g. `imageHint: "person at desk comparing two email drafts side by side"`)
5. Commit, push, open PR targeting `main`
6. Post the PR URL as a comment on this task
## Guidelines
- Write for busy professionals, not academics
- Voice: direct, conversational, zero corporate fluff
- Every article MUST have a FAQ section (4-5 questions)
- One PR per article
## When done
1. Set this task to `done`
2. @mention **@Content Manager** with all PR URLs so they can unblock the Designer
## Blocked on
Content Manager review of [{{seo_brief.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{seo_brief.identifier}}) SEO briefs.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Generate AI hero images for new articles
description: ## Daily Content Pipeline — {{date}}
Generate AI hero images for today's new articles and push them to the Copywriter's open PRs.
## Steps
For each article PR opened by the Copywriter:
1. `git fetch origin && git checkout <branch-name> && git pull origin <branch-name>`
2. Run `node scripts/generate-ai-images.mjs --slug <article-slug>` to generate the hero image
3. Review the generated image against brand guidelines (see `scripts/image-style-config.json` qualityCalibration section). Regenerate if it doesn't meet standards.
4. Verify the image is specific to the article content, not generic. The article's `imageHint` frontmatter field describes what the image should depict.
5. Commit the image + updated frontmatter, push to the same branch
6. Comment on this task confirming images are done
## Requirements
- `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN` must be set (load from `.env`)
- Work on the **same branch** as the Copywriter's PR — do NOT create a new branch
- Check PR URLs in [{{write_articles.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{write_articles.identifier}}) task comments
## When done
1. Set this task to `done`
2. @mention **@Content Manager** confirming all images are pushed, so they can unblock Legal review
## Blocked on
Copywriter PRs from [{{write_articles.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{write_articles.identifier}}). Look for PR URLs in that task's comments.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Legal compliance review of new articles
description: ## Daily Content Pipeline — {{date}}
Review today's article PRs for legal and compliance issues before publication.
## What to check
- GDPR compliance: no personal data collection claims without proper disclosure
- Affiliate/sponsorship disclosure if applicable
- No misleading claims about AI capabilities
- Copyright: no copied content, proper attribution
- Privacy policy consistency: if article references data handling, verify it matches our privacy policy
## Steps

For each article PR (find PR URLs in [{{hero_images.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{hero_images.identifier}}) and [{{write_articles.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{write_articles.identifier}}) task comments):
1. Read the article content in the PR branch
2. If **approved**: comment on this task "Approved: PR #XX" for each PR

3. If **changes needed**: create a new Paperclip task assigned to the relevant agent (Copywriter for content changes, Designer for image changes) with specific required fixes and a reference to the PR. Set this task to `blocked` until the fix task is done.
## When all PRs are approved
1. Set this task to `done`
2. @mention **@Content Manager** confirming legal approval so they can proceed with merge
## Blocked on
Images added to PRs by Frontend Designer [{{hero_images.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{hero_images.identifier}}).

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Final review and merge article PRs
description: ## Daily Content Pipeline — {{date}}
Final editorial review and merge of today's article PRs.
## Prerequisites
- All PRs have article content (Copywriter) + hero images (Designer)
- Legal review approved ([{{legal_review.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{legal_review.identifier}}))
## Steps
For each article PR:
1. Final editorial quality check (tone, structure, frontmatter completeness)
2. Verify hero image is present and appropriate
3. Verify CI passes
4. Merge PR to `main` using `gh pr merge <number> --merge --repo nio85/superdots-blog`
5. Verify deploy succeeded at https://superdots.sh
## After merging all PRs
Comment on parent task [{{_parent.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{_parent.identifier}}) with published article URLs. Close the parent task.
## Blocked on
Legal approval from [{{legal_review.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{legal_review.identifier}}).
